structure_description: Balance the adversary loss across label–protected-group cells so its gradient directly emphasizes both equalized-odds components without changing classifier capacity or training budget.
Moderately increase adversarial pressure so the cell-balanced adversary more strongly suppresses protected-group signal while limiting accuracy risk.

Reparameterize the same-capacity adversary as two independent label-conditional logistic heads, improving its ability to detect and suppress both equalized-odds gaps without increasing the training budget.
Linearly warm up the adversarial loss gradient for 500 updates to stabilize classifier learning before applying full debiasing pressure.
